failure_reproduction: The preflight showed that the connector always replaced the pull-request body with only the provider marker, so the mandatory repository template could not be satisfied.

fix.contract: ActionRequest params include body with a 65,536-character limit and a compatibility default of an empty string.
fix.approval_binding: body participates in params_hash and any change invalidates the prior ActionApproval.
fix.provider_effect: GitHub receives the reviewed body followed by exactly one stable provider marker.
fix.read_model: Legacy rows without body project an empty body; new rows preserve the reviewed body.

verification.command: Go target and HTTP API tests
